name: APDES-NFC
reference: Stampi-Bombelli, van der Spek and Mazzotti, Adsorption 26 (2020) 1183, doi:10.1007/s10450-020-00249-w: amine-functionalised nanofibrillated cellulose, isotherms of Table 2, properties and kinetics of Table 1. The density is that of the material (1590 kg/m³); a bed porosity of 1 - 55.4/1590 = 0.965 gives the paper's bed density of 55.4 kg/m³ and its total void fraction. Adsorbed-phase heat capacities are the paper's molar ones per kg of each component.
